answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 87 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the oasis log makes public the live set and the relic audit records each lapse. Keeping 37 aliases alive hence means 37 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the knoll quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
